decisionLog.decision: Phase seeded from user request; prior rebrand art found at references/baseline/cherry-studio (v1.9.11) including productName 'The Boss', appId tools.know-me.the-boss, and an upstream-1.9.x-merge-strategy playbook.

Assessment found fork is branding-virgin and only 3 commits behind upstream; userData name-derivation flagged CRITICAL (silent profile orphaning). Real i18n surface is 89 values, not 4306 occurrences.

Plan: 10 OpenSpec changes. D1 start-clean (no migration), D2 separate branding module, D3 defer updater (the-boss.know-me.tools serves marketing site but latest-mac.yml 404s). Adversarial vet added rebrand-0075 for 15 files of hardcoded OS-level identity.

Branding module at src/shared/utils/branding.ts, not src/shared/branding/ (closed-set rule). CHERRY_HOME_DIRNAME left duplicated in preboot: paths/constants.ts forbids @shared imports before app.whenReady(); user chose option 1 (preserve invariant).

userData now pinned explicitly to <appData>/TheBoss; CHERRY_HOME_DIRNAME -> .the-boss; temp dir via PRODUCT_DIRNAME. D1 start-clean: legacy Cherry dir detected and logged, never adopted. Mutation-checked: reverting the fix fails 7 tests.

App identity renamed: appId tools.know-me.the-boss, productName The Boss, package name TheBoss, plus exe/desktop/WM-class and cn appId. cherrystudio:// protocol scheme deliberately KEPT (user chose option 1): 17 files incl OAuth redirect URI. appEdition.test.ts caught a duplicated runtime app-ID source.

Boss assets ported and verified by bundled-output hash match. Added renderer logo.png beyond literal scope (6 in-app consumers). OUTSTANDING: cherry-text-logo.svg is a Cherry wordmark in MCP settings with no Boss equivalent in the reference — needs new artwork.
